name: BBI Burgerliches Brauhaus Immobilien AG
summary: BBI Bürgerliches Brauhaus Immobilien AG operates as a real estate company in Germany. It invests in and manages a portfolio of shopping centers and retail parks. The company is based in Neuburg an der Donau, Germany. BBI Bürgerliches Brauhaus Immobilien AG is a subsidiary of VIB Vermögen AG.
